# CodeOutbox

> Email marketing for developers. Paste a `<form>` (no backend), write broadcasts in
> Markdown, and operate it all from your coding agent over MCP. Lists and campaigns live in
> the repo as files. Free for 100 subscribers; open source.

CodeOutbox stores subscribers, handles double opt-in + consent, and sends email, so the
developer hosts nothing. Inbox-grade deliverability defaults (double opt-in, SPF/DKIM/DMARC,
one-click unsubscribe, suppression). To send broadcasts above the free-tier limit, the
account authenticates its own domain — the agent generates and verifies the DNS records.

## Capture (no backend)

Paste this; submissions become pending subscribers and get a double-opt-in email.
`{form_id}` is your list's unguessable public id (from `co groups` / the dashboard);
list slugs are namespaced per account, so the public id is what the form posts to:

```html
<form action="https://demo.codeoutbox.com/f/{form_id}" method="POST">
  <input type="email" name="email" required />
  <button>Subscribe</button>
</form>
```

- `POST /f/{form_id}` accepts `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or `application/json`.
- Fields: `email` (required), optional `name`, hidden `_gotcha` (honeypot). Any other
  input (e.g. `company`) is stored as a custom field for merge tags.
- `npx codeoutbox` (no account needed: creates a list you claim later; or `--id {form_id}`) detects the stack (React/Next, Vue/Nuxt, Svelte, Astro,
  HTML; Tailwind or not) and writes a styled form component into the project.
- `Accept: application/json` → `{ "ok": true, "status": "pending" }`; otherwise 303 redirect.

## Broadcasts (Markdown)

A campaign is YAML frontmatter + Markdown:

```markdown
---
subject: Launch week is here
group: newsletter
---
Hello — here's what shipped this week…
```

Send with the CLI or API: `co send campaigns/launch.md --live`.

- Merge tags: `{{first_name}}`, `{{name}}`, `{{email}}`, any custom field `{{company}}`,
  fallbacks `{{first_name | "there"}}`. Values are escaped; previews warn on missing data.
- Frontmatter: `send_at` (ISO, schedules), `draft: true` (previewable, never sent),
  `preheader`, `from`.
- Sends are idempotent per content+list: re-sending the same file never double-sends.

## GitHub Action

`uses: Cellcote/CodeOutbox/action@main` with `api-token`. On `pull_request` it comments
with each changed campaign's subject, list, recipient count, warnings and a rendered
preview link; on `push` to the default branch it sends them (drafts skipped).

## CLI (`co`)

- `co sync [codeoutbox.json]` — reconcile declared lists (config-as-code).
- `co send <file> [--live]` — preview (dry-run) or send a broadcast.
- `co domains add|verify|list <subdomain>` — authenticate a sending domain (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
- `co token create [--name]` — create an API token.
- `co dev [--port]` — local form catcher for testing (no real emails).
- `co share <list>` — hosted signup page URL + README badge; `co archive on|off <list>`.
- `co subscribers list|export <list> [--json]` — list or export (CSV/JSON).
- `co subscribers import <list> <file.csv|json> --confirmed|--send-optin` — import
  (Mailchimp/Kit/Substack CSV exports work as-is; extra columns → custom fields).

Auth: `CO_TOKEN` (API token) as `Authorization: Bearer`. Server: `CO_URL`.

## MCP (agent control)

An MCP stdio server exposes: `list_groups`, `create_group`, `subscriber_count`,
`add_subscriber`, `preview_broadcast`, `send_broadcast` (confirm-gated), `add_domain`, `verify_domain`,
`list_domains`. Configure via `.mcp.json` with `CO_URL` + `CO_TOKEN`.

## Sign up (instant)

`POST /signup { email }` → magic-link email → open it → you get an account + an API key
(shown once). Use the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` for the API below.

## Control-plane API (authd; Bearer token)

- `GET/POST /v1/groups` (lists), `GET /v1/groups/{slug}/count`
- **Subscribers (programmatic — push your SaaS's users):**
  - `POST /v1/groups/{list}/subscribers` `{ email, name?, fields?, confirmed? }`
    (`confirmed:true` asserts prior consent → no opt-in email)
  - `POST /v1/groups/{list}/subscribers/import` `{ subscribers:[...], confirmed? }`
  - `GET /v1/groups/{list}/subscribers`, `DELETE /v1/groups/{list}/subscribers/{email}`
  - `GET /v1/groups/{list}/subscribers/export?format=csv|json`
- `POST /v1/broadcasts/preview` (`{ share: true }` adds a public `previewUrl`),
  `POST /v1/broadcasts` (requires `{ "confirm": true }`)
- `POST/GET /v1/domains`, `POST /v1/domains/{id}/verify`
- `GET/POST /v1/tokens`, `DELETE /v1/tokens/{id}`
- Zero-signup: `POST /v1/provisional { slug?, email? }` (no auth) → `{ public_id, form_url,
  claim_url, page_url }`. Unclaimed: double opt-in, ≤25 subscribers, deleted after 14 days.
- `PUT /v1/groups/{slug}/archive { enabled }` — list past issues on the hosted page.
- Public: `GET /l/{public_id}` (hosted signup page), `GET /l/{public_id}/{issue}`
  (archived issue), `GET /badge/{public_id}?style=join` (subscriber-count SVG), `GET /confirm/{token}`,
  `GET|POST /unsubscribe/{token}`

## Pricing

Free (100 subscribers, ~1k sends/mo, shared subdomain) · Pro $9/mo (3,000, own domain) ·
Growth $19/mo (10,000) · Scale $49/mo (50,000) · Business $149/mo (150,000) · Max $299/mo (500,000). No credit card for free.
